about: Sky Revolver is a guns blazing old-school shoot-em-up game just like they did in ‘90s! You play as a hotheaded space pilot destined to destroy the evil Empire. Your main goal is to survive through the endless waves of enemy spaceships and shuttles and to defeat the high command!
● Large variety of enemies and bosses
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
